_doc: Clip theo lỗi L1 của người học ngôn ngữ này (docs/specs/social-l1-clips.md). Giáo viên nói tiếng Anh ≤B1; native.* = bản tay (tầng i18n-fixed), {m:từ[#nghĩa]} lấy nghĩa từ web/packs/<lang>.json (vi: kho từ).

mistake.en: Mixing up L and R (light / right)
mistake.vi: Lẫn L và R: "light" / "right" (tiếng Nhật chỉ có một âm giữa L và R)
mistake.l1: Japanese has one liquid sound between L and R.

segments.text: Light, or right? These are two different words.
Light. Your tongue touches the top of your mouth, just behind your teeth. Light.
Right. Your tongue does not touch anything. Right.
Repeat after me. Turn right at the light.

native.hook: LとRの違い、聞き分けられる？
native.caption: “light”（{m:light}）と“right”（{m:right#2}）、同じに聞こえますか？Lは舌先を上の歯のすぐ後ろにつけて、Rは舌をどこにもつけません。Ama先生のあとに続けて言ってみよう！Lexkiteアプリで発音を練習。

en.hook: Can you hear the difference between L and R?
en.caption: Do “light” ({m:light}) and “right” ({m:right#2}) sound the same to you? For L, touch the tip of your tongue just behind your top teeth; for R, your tongue touches nothing. Repeat after teacher Ama! Practice pronunciation in the Lexkite app.
